Intangible: An abstract thing that is not a physical object: a quantity, structured value, or concept. Also called abstraction, concept.
Enumeration: A fixed list of predefined values, such as a set of genres or cuisines. Also called enumeration, value list, controlled vocabulary.
StatusEnumeration: An enumeration of status values. Also called status list, state enumeration.
StructuredValue: A value with a complex structure rather than a simple text or reference. Also called structured data value.
QuantitativeValue: A numeric value or interval for a characteristic, with a unit. Also called measured value, numeric value. Examples: '5 cm', '20–30'.
QuantitativeValueDistribution: A statistical distribution of numeric values. Also called value distribution.
QualitativeValue: A predefined non-numeric value for a characteristic, such as a size or plug type. Also called qualitative value, category value. Examples: 'S', 'M', 'L'.
MonetaryAmount: An amount or range of money. Also called sum, monetary value, amount of money. Examples: '$50 USD'.
MonetaryAmountDistribution: A statistical distribution of monetary amounts. Also called money distribution.
PriceSpecification: A structured representation of a price or price range. Also called pricing, price detail.
UnitPriceSpecification: The price asked per unit for an offer. Also called unit price.
DeliveryChargeSpecification: The price for delivery using a particular method. Also called delivery cost, shipping charge.
PaymentChargeSpecification: The cost of settling payment via a particular method. Also called payment fee.
ExchangeRateSpecification: A structured value representing a currency exchange rate. Also called exchange rate, FX rate.
RepaymentSpecification: A structured value representing loan repayment terms. Also called repayment terms.
DatedMoneySpecification: A monetary value with optional start and end dates. Also called dated amount.
PriceComponentTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of price components making up a total price. Also called price component type.
PriceTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of price types such as list, invoice, or sale price. Also called price type.
GeoCoordinates: The latitude and longitude of a place or event. Also called coordinates, geolocation, lat-long. Examples: 33.89, 35.50.
GeoShape: The geographic shape of a place defined by coordinate points. Also called geographic shape, area shape.
GeoCircle: A circular geographic area defined by a centre and radius. Also called geo circle.
GeospatialGeometry: A geospatial geometry describing a place's shape. Also called spatial geometry.
PostalAddress: A mailing address. Also called address, postal address, mailing address.
PostalCodeRangeSpecification: A range of postal codes. Also called postcode range, ZIP range.
ContactPoint: A means of contacting an organisation, such as a department. Also called contact, contact details.
ContactPointOption: An enumerated option related to a contact point. Also called contact option.
ServiceChannel: A means of accessing a service, such as an office, website, or phone. Also called service access point.
EntryPoint: An entry point within a web-based protocol or action. Also called endpoint, access point.
OpeningHoursSpecification: A structured value giving the opening hours of a place. Also called opening hours, business hours.
LocationFeatureSpecification: A property-value feature of an accommodation. Also called amenity, facility feature.
PropertyValue: A property-value pair describing a feature. Also called attribute, characteristic, property.
PropertyValueSpecification: A specification of a property value. Also called value specification.
TypeAndQuantityNode: A structured value giving quantity, unit, and function of bundled goods. Also called quantity node.
OwnershipInfo: Information about when an entity owned a product. Also called ownership record.
EngineSpecification: Information about a vehicle's engine. Also called engine spec, engine details.
WarrantyPromise: A structured value for the duration and scope of a warranty. Also called warranty, guarantee.
WarrantyScope: The range of services covered by a warranty. Also called warranty coverage.
Audience: The intended audience for an item. Also called target audience, intended viewers.
PeopleAudience: An audience defined by characteristics of people. Also called target demographic.
BusinessAudience: An audience of businesses. Also called business target audience.
EducationalAudience: An audience for educational content. Also called learner audience.
MedicalAudience: An audience for medical content. Also called clinical audience.
MedicalAudienceType: An enumeration of medical audience types. Also called medical audience category.
ParentAudience: An audience of parents interested in content. Also called parental audience.
Researcher: A person or audience engaged in research. Also called scientist, scholar, investigator.
Role: Additional information about a relationship, such as a time period or character name. Also called role, capacity.
OrganizationRole: A role within an organisation. Also called organisational role.
EmployeeRole: A role describing an employment relationship. Also called employment role, job role.
LinkRole: A role representing a web link. Also called link, hyperlink role.
PerformanceRole: A role an entity plays in a theatrical performance. Also called acting role, part.
Offer: An offer to sell, rent, or provide rights to an item or service. Also called deal, listing, sale offer.
AggregateOffer: An offer aggregating multiple offers for the same product. Also called combined offer, price aggregation.
OfferForLease: An offer to lease out something. Also called lease offer, rental offer.
OfferForPurchase: An offer to sell something. Also called purchase offer, sale offer.
OfferCatalog: A list of related offers from one provider. Also called offer list, catalogue.
Demand: An announcement seeking certain goods or services. Also called want, request, demand.
Order: A confirmation of a transaction containing line items. Also called purchase order, receipt.
OrderItem: A single line of an order with quantity and shipping. Also called line item, order line.
OrderStatus: An enumerated status value for an order. Also called order state.
ParcelDelivery: The delivery of a parcel via postal or commercial service. Also called shipment, package delivery.
Service: A service provided by an organisation, such as delivery or printing. Also called offering, service.
FoodService: A food service such as breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Also called catering, meal service.
TaxiService: A vehicle-for-hire service with a driver. Also called taxi, cab service, ride service.
Taxi: A licensed vehicle for hire with a driver. Also called cab, taxicab.
PaymentService: A service to transfer funds to a beneficiary. Also called payment provider, money transfer service.
CurrencyConversionService: A service to convert money between currencies. Also called currency exchange, money exchange.
BroadcastService: A service delivering content via broadcast over air or online. Also called broadcaster, channel service.
RadioBroadcastService: A service delivering radio content. Also called radio service, radio broadcaster.
CableOrSatelliteService: A service providing TV or radio via cable or satellite. Also called cable service, satellite service.
WebAPI: An application programming interface accessible over the web. Also called web API, REST API.
FinancialProduct: A product offered by a financial institution. Also called financial service, banking product.
BankAccount: A bank product for depositing, withdrawing, or transferring money. Also called account.
DepositAccount: A bank account for depositing funds to earn interest. Also called savings account.
BrokerageAccount: An account for depositing funds and placing investment orders. Also called investment account, trading account.
InvestmentOrDeposit: A financial product where funds are placed for potential return. Also called investment.
InvestmentFund: A fund pooling investor capital to invest in assets. Also called fund, mutual fund.
LoanOrCredit: A financial product loaning money or credit under terms. Also called loan, credit, line of credit.
MortgageLoan: A loan secured against real estate. Also called mortgage, home loan.
CreditCard: A card payment method tied to a credit account. Also called credit card. Examples: Visa, MasterCard.
PaymentCard: A card payment method tied to an account. Also called bank card, debit card.
PaymentMethod: A standardised procedure for transferring payment. Also called payment option, method of payment. Examples: cash, PayPal.
PaymentMethodType: An enumeration of generic payment method types. Also called payment type.
PaymentStatusType: An enumerated payment status such as due or complete. Also called payment status.
FinancialIncentive: A financial incentive offered for goods or services. Also called incentive, rebate, subsidy.
Grant: A grant of resources, typically financial, from a funder. Also called funding, award, grant.
MonetaryGrant: A grant of money. Also called monetary award, cash grant.
JobPosting: A listing describing a job opening. Also called job ad, job listing, vacancy.
Occupation: A profession or occupation. Also called profession, job, vocation, career. Examples: nurse, engineer.
OccupationalExperienceRequirements: Employment experience requirements for a role. Also called experience requirements.
EducationalOccupationalProgram: A program leading to a credential like a degree. Also called academic program, degree program.
WorkBasedProgram: A program combining education and employment, such as an apprenticeship. Also called apprenticeship, work placement.
Permit: A permit issued by an organisation, such as a parking pass. Also called permit, licence, pass.
Reservation: A booking for travel, dining, or an event. Also called booking, reservation.
ReservationPackage: A group of reservations sharing common values. Also called booking package.
LodgingReservation: A reservation for lodging at a hotel or inn. Also called hotel booking, room reservation.
FoodEstablishmentReservation: A reservation to dine at a food business. Also called restaurant booking, table reservation.
EventReservation: A reservation for an event such as a concert. Also called event booking, ticket reservation.
BoatReservation: A reservation for boat travel. Also called ferry booking.
BusReservation: A reservation for bus travel. Also called bus booking, coach booking.
TrainReservation: A reservation for train travel. Also called rail booking, train booking.
TaxiReservation: A reservation for a taxi. Also called cab booking.
RentalCarReservation: A reservation for a rental car. Also called car hire booking.
ReservationStatusType: An enumerated status value for a reservation. Also called reservation status.
TouristTrip: An itinerary of visits to places of interest. Also called tour, sightseeing trip.
BoatTrip: A trip on a commercial ferry line. Also called ferry trip, ferry crossing.
BusTrip: A trip on a commercial bus line. Also called bus journey, coach trip.
TrainTrip: A trip on a commercial train line. Also called rail journey, train trip.
Seat: A seat, such as a reserved seat at an event. Also called place, seating.
VirtualLocation: An online or virtual location for attending events. Also called online venue, virtual venue.
Language: A natural language such as English or Hindi. Also called tongue, natural language. Examples: Spanish, Arabic.
ComputerLanguage: A programming or computer language such as Python or Lisp. Also called programming language, coding language.
Class: A class or type, equivalent to rdfs:Class. Also called type, category, rdfs:Class.
Property: A property indicating an attribute or relationship of a thing. Also called attribute, relation, rdf:Property.
DefinedTerm: A word or phrase with a formal definition, as in a glossary. Also called term, defined term, entry.
CategoryCode: A category code from a coding scheme. Also called category code, classification code.
MedicalCode: A code identifying a medical entity. Also called medical code, diagnostic code. Examples: ICD-10 code.
Specialty: A field in which people develop specific expertise. Also called speciality, area of expertise.
MedicalSpecialty: A branch of medical science or practice. Also called medical speciality. Examples: cardiology, oncology.
MedicineSystem: A system of medical practice. Also called system of medicine. Examples: Ayurveda, Western medicine.
Rating: An evaluation on a numeric scale, such as 1–5 stars. Also called score, rating.
AggregateRating: An average rating from multiple ratings or reviews. Also called overall rating, average score.
EndorsementRating: A rating expressing endorsement, such as a critic's pick. Also called endorsement, approval rating.
ItemList: An ordered or unordered list of items. Also called list, listing, ranking.
BreadcrumbList: A trail of linked pages showing navigation hierarchy. Also called breadcrumbs, navigation trail.
ListItem: An item within a list, such as a step. Also called list entry, list element.
HowToItem: An item used as a tool or supply in a how-to. Also called material, item.
HowToSupply: A supply consumed when following a how-to. Also called material, ingredient.
HowToTool: A tool used but not consumed in a how-to. Also called tool, implement.
MenuItem: A food or drink item listed in a menu. Also called dish, menu entry.
DataFeedItem: A single item within a data feed. Also called feed item, feed entry.
Series: A group of related items, typically published in sequence. Also called series, sequence.
Observation: A measured observation about an entity at a time. Also called measurement, data point.
StatisticalPopulation: A set of instances of a type satisfying constraints. Also called statistical population, population set.
StatisticalVariable: A statistical metric measurable at a place and time. Also called statistical variable, metric.
ConstraintNode: A node whose properties serve to constrain rather than describe an entity. Also called constraint node.
InteractionCounter: A summary of how users interacted with content. Also called interaction count, engagement metric.
ProgramMembership: Membership in a loyalty or club program. Also called membership, club membership.
MemberProgram: A loyalty or membership program offering benefits. Also called loyalty program, rewards program.
MemberProgramTier: A tier within a membership program, such as gold. Also called membership tier, loyalty tier.
MediaSubscription: A subscription giving access to media. Also called subscription, media plan.
NutritionInformation: Nutritional facts about a recipe or food. Also called nutrition facts, nutritional info.
RestrictedDiet: A diet restricted for cultural, religious, or health reasons. Also called special diet, dietary restriction. Examples: vegan, kosher, halal.
GameServer: A server providing interaction in a multiplayer game. Also called game server.
BroadcastChannel: A channel instance of a broadcast service in a lineup. Also called channel.
RadioChannel: A radio channel instance in a broadcast lineup. Also called radio station channel.
AMRadioChannel: An AM radio channel. Also called AM station, AM channel.
FMRadioChannel: An FM radio channel. Also called FM station, FM channel.
TelevisionChannel: A TV channel instance in a broadcast lineup. Also called TV channel, station.
BroadcastFrequencySpecification: The frequency and modulation of a broadcast service. Also called frequency, broadcast frequency.
MerchantReturnPolicy: A policy on returning products. Also called returns policy, refund policy.
MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride: A seasonal override of a return policy. Also called holiday return policy.
ShippingDeliveryTime: Information about delivery times for shipping. Also called delivery time, shipping time.
ShippingRateSettings: Reusable shipping rate information. Also called shipping rates.
ShippingService: Criteria for whether and how an offer can be shipped. Also called shipping option.
ShippingConditions: Constraints and information about shipping conditions. Also called shipping terms.
ServicePeriod: A duration with cutoff and business-day constraints. Also called handling time, service window.
FloorPlan: A representation of similar accommodations with shared details. Also called floor plan, layout.
BedType: A type of bed available in an accommodation. Also called bed category.
SizeSpecification: Size-related properties of a product. Also called size, size spec.
EnergyConsumptionDetails: Information about a product's energy efficiency. Also called energy details, energy label.
CDCPMDRecord: A data record in a CDC hospital reporting format. Also called CDC record.
HealthPlanFormulary: The drug cost and coverage spec of a health plan. Also called formulary, drug list.
HealthPlanNetwork: A health insurance plan network. Also called insurance network, provider network.
HealthPlanCostSharingSpecification: A description of patient costs under a health plan. Also called cost sharing, copay spec.
PhysicalExam: A physical examination of a patient by a physician. Also called physical exam, checkup.
DigitalDocumentPermission: A permission to access a digital document. Also called document permission, access permission.
SpeakableSpecification: Sections of a document marked as speakable for voice. Also called speakable content.
AlignmentObject: An alignment between a learning resource and an educational framework. Also called educational alignment.
Error: A representation of an error. Also called error, fault.
InstantaneousEvent: An event with no duration, like a log entry. Also called instantaneous event, point event.
GameServerStatus: An enumerated status of a game server. Also called server status.
ActionStatusType: An enumerated status of an action. Also called action status.
EventStatusType: An enumerated status that an event may be in. Also called event status.
MedicalStudyStatus: An enumerated status of a medical study. Also called study status.
GamePlayMode: An indicator of whether a game is single- or multi-player. Also called play mode.
GameAvailabilityEnumeration: An enumeration of game availability kinds. Also called game availability.
ActionAccessSpecification: Requirements that must be met to perform an action. Also called access requirements.
DigitalPlatformEnumeration: An enumeration of common technology platforms. Also called platform type.
DigitalDocumentPermissionType: An enumeration of permission types for documents. Also called permission type.
BoardingPolicyType: An enumeration of airline boarding policies. Also called boarding policy.
BookFormatType: An enumeration of book publication formats. Also called book format. Examples: hardcover, ebook.
BusinessEntityType: An enumeration of legal forms of an organisation. Also called business type, legal form.
BusinessFunction: The type of activity offered through an offer, such as sell or lease. Also called business function.
CarUsageType: An enumeration of special car usages, such as taxi or rental. Also called car usage.
DeliveryMethod: A standardised method of delivering a product. Also called delivery option, shipping method.
FulfillmentTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of product fulfilment types. Also called fulfilment type.
GenderType: An enumeration of genders. Also called gender.
ItemAvailability: An enumeration of product availability options. Also called availability, stock status.
ItemListOrderType: An enumeration of how an ordered list is organised. Also called list order.
OfferItemCondition: An enumeration of item conditions, such as new or used. Also called item condition.
RsvpResponseType: An enumeration of RSVP responses. Also called RSVP status.
DriveWheelConfigurationValue: A value indicating which wheels receive torque. Also called drive type. Examples: front-wheel drive, AWD.
SteeringPositionValue: A value indicating steering wheel position. Also called steering side. Examples: left-hand drive.
MapCategoryType: An enumeration of kinds of map. Also called map type.
MediaEnumeration: An enumeration of codes describing media objects. Also called media code.
MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration: Codes indicating the authenticity of a media object. Also called media authenticity rating.
IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration: IPTC codes describing the source of a digital media object. Also called digital source type.
EventAttendanceModeEnumeration: An enumeration of event attendance modes (online or offline). Also called attendance mode.
DrugCostCategory: An enumeration of medical drug cost categories. Also called drug cost type.
DrugPregnancyCategory: An enumeration of fetal-risk categories for drugs in pregnancy. Also called pregnancy category.
DrugPrescriptionStatus: An enumeration of whether a drug is prescription or OTC. Also called prescription status.
InfectiousAgentClass: An enumeration of classes of infectious agents. Also called pathogen class.
MedicalDevicePurpose: An enumeration of medical device purposes. Also called device purpose.
MedicalEnumeration: An enumeration related to health and medicine. Also called medical enumeration.
MedicalEvidenceLevel: An enumeration of evidence levels for medical guidelines. Also called evidence level.
MedicalImagingTechnique: An enumeration of medical imaging modalities. Also called imaging technique. Examples: MRI, CT.
MedicalObservationalStudyDesign: An enumeration of observational study designs. Also called study design.
MedicalProcedureType: An enumeration of medical procedure types. Also called procedure type.
MedicalTrialDesign: An enumeration of medical trial designs. Also called trial design.
PhysicalActivityCategory: An enumeration of physical activity categories. Also called activity type.
HealthAspectEnumeration: An enumeration of aspects of health content. Also called health aspect.
GovernmentBenefitsType: An enumeration of government benefit kinds. Also called benefit type.
BodyMeasurementTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of body measurement types. Also called body measurement.
MeasurementTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of measurement types or dimensions. Also called measurement type.
MeasurementMethodEnum: An enumeration of measurement methods. Also called measurement method.
WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of wearable measurement types. Also called wearable measurement.
SizeGroupEnumeration: An enumeration of product size groups. Also called size group.
SizeSystemEnumeration: An enumeration of size systems. Also called size system. Examples: UK, Imperial.
WearableSizeGroupEnumeration: An enumeration of wearable size groups. Also called wearable size group.
WearableSizeSystemEnumeration: An enumeration of wearable size systems. Also called wearable size system.
EnergyEfficiencyEnumeration: An enumeration of energy efficiency levels. Also called energy class, efficiency rating.
EUEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration: An enumeration of EU energy efficiency classes A–G. Also called EU energy class.
EnergyStarEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration: An indicator of EnergyStar certification. Also called EnergyStar rating.
CertificationStatusEnumeration: An enumeration of certification statuses. Also called certification status.
AdultOrientedEnumeration: An enumeration of adult-only product considerations. Also called adult content flag.
DENonprofitType: A German non-profit organisation type. Also called German nonprofit type.
ITNonprofitType: An Italian non-profit organisation type. Also called Italian nonprofit type.
NLNonprofitType: A Dutch non-profit organisation type. Also called Netherlands nonprofit type.
UKNonprofitType: A UK non-profit organisation type. Also called British nonprofit type.
USNonprofitType: A US non-profit organisation type. Also called American nonprofit type.
NonprofitType: An enumeration of official non-profit organisation types. Also called nonprofit type.
LegalValueLevel: An enumeration of legal validity levels for legislation. Also called legal value.
IncentiveQualifiedExpenseType: An enumeration of expenses covered by an incentive. Also called qualified expense.
IncentiveStatus: An enumeration of incentive statuses. Also called incentive status.
IncentiveType: An enumeration of financial incentive types. Also called incentive type. Examples: tax credit, rebate.
PurchaseType: An enumeration of purchase types for an item. Also called purchase type.
MerchantReturnEnumeration: An enumeration of product return policy kinds. Also called return policy type.
RefundTypeEnumeration: An enumeration of refund types. Also called refund type.
ReturnFeesEnumeration: An enumeration of return fee policies. Also called return fee type.
ReturnLabelSourceEnumeration: An enumeration of return label types. Also called return label source.
ReturnMethodEnumeration: An enumeration of product return methods. Also called return method.
TierBenefitEnumeration: An enumeration of loyalty program benefits. Also called tier benefit.
MusicAlbumProductionType: An enumeration of album production types. Also called album type. Examples: studio album, live album.
MusicAlbumReleaseType: An enumeration of album release types. Also called release type. Examples: single, EP.
MusicReleaseFormatType: An enumeration of music release formats. Also called release format. Examples: CD, LP, digital.
